title: New Orleans big bands of the 1930s
summary: Local big bands including Desvigne, Celestin, Clyde Kerr and Sidney Kitts.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: Well what were some of the big bands in New Orleans in the 30's?
Sidney Desby and Papa Celestan, the sunny southern Senko Piers, headed by a man named Richard McNeil. Clowns doesn't do them, he was in and out of here, so he was in and out of here.

Clyde Carr came up in the, here this year. I worked with Clyde Carr. I worked with Clyde Carr for about 5 years. Clyde Carr the Rap Solians, you heard of them? I heard of the Rap Solians, yeah. Mmhmm. Sidney Kitts had a big band. Mmhmm. They had the Moonlight Serenators. Mmhmm. They had more than that, I'm trying to think of them. Yes. And big bands were popular in those days. Hell yeah.
